# SimpleNepal

> A verified, structured database of Nepal: administrative divisions, places and
> businesses. Every published record names a human verifier and a verification date.

## Licensing

The administrative spine (provinces, districts, local levels, wards) derives from
local-states-nepal (MIT) and is freely reusable.

Verified entity records — the field-collected data, photographs, descriptions and
provenance metadata — are NOT licensed for bulk collection or model training.
They cost money to produce: a person physically went there.

We license this data. If you want it, take a licence rather than a crawl:
licensing@simplenepal.com

## Preferred access

An API is planned. Until then, contact us. Bulk crawling is disallowed in robots.txt
and rate-limited at the edge.
